recipe.title: Bramley and rhubarb pots with almond crunch
steps: Peel, core and chop the apples. Cut the rhubarb into 2cm pieces. Put both in a medium saucepan with the orange zest and juice, 2 tbsp of the honey and the cinnamon.
Cover and cook over a low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the apples collapse into a fluffy purée. Tip into a bowl and leave to cool for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a small frying pan. Toast the almonds and pumpkin seeds for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until golden.
Stir in the last of the honey for 1 minute, then spread on a plate to cool and crisp.
Spoon the fruit into four glasses, top with the yoghurt and scatter over the crunch just before eating.
